##### Project general facts

Avanti Tower is a contemporary 15-storey residential development offering furnished studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, designed to provide residents with a vantage point to get the most out of vibrant city life. This exceptional tower features a wealth of state-of-the-art facilities that create an experience beyond the ordinary, while contemporary design elements in both architecture and interior finishes provide a modern and stylish living environment. With a passion for meticulous craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and glorious finishing, Avanti raises the standards of elite living.

The development offers a range of state-of-the-art facilities designed to enhance every aspect of daily living, including a health and fitness club that caters to residents' wellbeing. Every need is catered to in style, with contemporary amenities just round the corner that add up to a hugely fulfilling experience. The exceptional location ensures residents can get the most out of vibrant city life while enjoying the comfort of their luxury home.

Each residence features thoughtful design and glorious finishing, creating living spaces that exude modern elegance and sophistication. The luxury apartments come with fully fitted kitchens including premium appliances such as washers, dryers, ovens, and refrigerators, ensuring effortless everyday living. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment that residents will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Business Bay, an incredible location in the centre of town that offers the ultimate lifestyle for people seeking a lively community. The area is not just office spaces and buildings; it features hotel towers, amazing restaurants, and wonderful residential properties that create a truly integrated urban environment. The community is known to be very stylish and up-to-date with the latest trends and gadgets, offering a fast-paced lifestyle with music festivals, celebrations, and numerous events throughout the year.

The neighborhood offers every contemporary amenity just round the corner, with famous international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, and banks and finance centers all within minutes of residents' homes. The lifestyle that Business Bay offers has many advantages, elevating the standard of living with easy and intuitive options in close proximity. The area's strategic location on the south side of Downtown Dubai ensures convenient access to key destinations throughout the city.

The area hosts plenty of events to keep things lively, including music festivals, Mother's Day celebrations, New Year's celebrations, and many others. The convenient access to essential services and amenities elevates the standard of living with easy and intuitive options close at hand. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of vibrant community living, urban convenience, and lifestyle appeal, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most dynamic and desirable districts.
